description: Git guard: a PreToolUse hook on Bash that refuses `git add -A`, `git add --all`, `git add .` and wildcard pathspecs — the staging commands CLAUDE.md forbids because the working tree may hold legacy live-credential run artefacts. Blocks with the reason; everything else passes.

hooks.command: p="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/git_guard.py"; python3 "$p"; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 127 ]; then python "$p"; rc=$?; fi; exit $rc
